column1: # winetoolz download catalog — every redistributable the installers fetch.
#   <key>  <sha256, or - for links the vendor updates in place>  <cache file name>  <url> [mirror ...]
# Pinned sums are the ones winetricks verifies for the same files (fxc2, d3drm:
# checked against downloads of the pinned URLs). An unpinned file must still
# be a real installer (magic bytes) and is fetched again after 30 days.
# Mirrors are only ever used for pinned files.
# --- DirectX redistributables (cabinets the DLL Installer takes DLLs from) ---
# --- .NET Desktop Runtimes (latest patch of each version) ---
